# ActiveLoom Documentation Index for Coding Agents

> Reusable engineering workflows, adversarial review protocols, verifiable commit ledgers, and bounded automation for Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini.

Use this index to load only the specific workflow or reference needed for your current task. For full context ingestion in one request, fetch https://activeloom.dev/llms-full.txt.

## Agent Entry Guide

- [Agent Entry Guide](https://activeloom.dev/agent-guide.md): Copyable session prompt, task-to-skill selector, prerequisites, and source ownership map.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/loomantix/activeloom): Upstream source repository (Apache 2.0).

## Core Engineering Skills

- [grill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/prompts/skills/grill/SKILL.md): Relentless pre-code interview that stress-tests a plan or design until nothing is silently assumed.
- [diagnosing-bugs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/prompts/skills/diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md): Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and regressions: isolate, repro, RCA, minimal verified fix.
- [feature-dev](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/prompts/skills/feature-dev/SKILL.md): Guided feature development with codebase understanding and architecture focus.
- [task-packet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/prompts/skills/task-packet/SKILL.md): Execute an implementation task packet end-to-end (code, tests, PR, closure).
- [agent-loop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/prompts/skills/agent-loop/SKILL.md): Autonomous issue implementation loop with strict allowlisting, isolated worktrees, and draft-PR review hooks.
- [critique](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/prompts/skills/critique/SKILL.md): PR-first adversarial review. Posts verified findings inline before fixing. Lean mode (2 signal lanes) vs Deep mode.
- [deepcritique](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/prompts/skills/deepcritique/SKILL.md): Exhaustive multi-lane review for high blast-radius changes.

## Review Protocols & Ledgers

- [Review Workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/.codex/REVIEW_WORKFLOW.md): Canonical PR-first review lifecycle, review tiers (Lean vs Deep), and multi-engine convergence.
- [Review Ledger Protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loomantix/activeloom/main/docs/review-learning-loop.md): JSON cryptographic evidence binding review findings and signatures to exact Git commit SHAs.

## CLI & Installation

- CLI commands:
  - `npx activeloom init --harness codex,claude,gemini`: Initialize repository with selected harness trees.
  - `npx activeloom add <skill> --harness <id>`: Install a specific skill personal/locally.
  - `npx activeloom init --sync`: Add weekly scheduled GitHub Actions workflow proposing updates via PRs.
- Requirements: Node 18.17+ or Python 3.9+.
